primary_body_assessment.ledger_findings: Every counted record has an actual source URL, time or disclosed batch window, version/date, substantive sections/posts, investigator summary, explicit limit, and D1 level. The counted core fields matched the original ledgers at the initial comparison. M07 was corrected in its original ledger during this review.
primary_body_assessment.not_just_snippets: No counted record is labelled metadata-only, heading-only, or search-snippet-only. The cited counterexample search false positives were opened and corrected, rather than counted from the snippet.
primary_body_assessment.failure_handling: M16's failed repeat access in ROOT_READING remains a repeat failure; it does not erase the earlier investigator's documented successful body reading. The new S25 JSON access failure is retained under excluded, while the same post's HTML body and the thread body were successfully opened.
primary_body_assessment.limits: This is an audit of the preserved body-reading observations plus targeted S25 revalidation, not a fresh independent re-reading of all 26 external documents.

crossfield_comparisons.supports: CROSSFIELD separates citation-derived gold, selection by citation count, final-claim revision leakage, expert augmentation, and document-versus-passage/combined-evidence units.
gold_bias_limits_preserved: CLEF's manual comparison is limited to 12 topics, seven experts, and depth20; different topic coverage prevents interpreting rank changes as a clean causal effect of qrel completion.
The 13/34 citation disagreement is a bounded observation, not an estimated omission rate for design proposals.
NTCIR expert/manual/system-pool augmentation shows a possible evaluation practice, not a transferable legal relevance criterion or an automatic remedy for this corpus.
Thirty pooled runs are not thirty distinct systems or teams; M07's original ledger wording was corrected.

crossfield_comparisons.supports: CROSSFIELD distinguishes noticed-case retrieval from passage entailment and records suppression of explicit citations.
gold_bias_limits_preserved: The absence of a guarantee covering all uncited relevant cases is stated as a limitation/inference, not an empirically measured omission rate.
Citation masking is not claimed to remove model pretraining memory or all leakage.
No legal-search rate is projected onto design-proposal usefulness or demand.

crossfield_comparisons.supports: CROSSFIELD distinguishes reproducing actual author references from ideal useful references and notes metadata/self-citation effects and completed-paper input timing.
gold_bias_limits_preserved: The 15/17 frequency is restricted to the reviewed local citation-recommendation approaches, not all scholarly citations or software designs.
Possible familiarity, visibility, access, and space constraints do not become an estimate of design-document omission.
Time-split evaluation is not equated with a pristine pre-writing information need; citation accuracy is not user utility.
The discussion explicitly refuses both 'crossfield principles are useless' and 'hidden demand is established' inferences.

source_reuse_privacy_and_storage.document_reuse: Repeated reads, history versions, root confirmations, and the new S25 post/thread views remain support evidence for their existing documents. M24 is substantive discussion and M25 its separate decision announcement; only M24 supplies a review-discussion slot. S25 is a review document used alongside a selected proposal, not a duplicate of the proposal text.
source_reuse_privacy_and_storage.case_and_noncase_separation: Using a selected case's separate original review thread for the review-source minimum is not double-counting the historical proposal document; it must not inflate case or gold denominators.
source_reuse_privacy_and_storage.privacy_inspection: Inspected structured keys and email-pattern presence in 68 source-evidence JSON files including the consolidated ledger and the relevant methods/template/history/counterexample ledgers. No saved author usernames, emails, profiles, raw forum body, or full third-party text field was found. Broader-pattern matches were boolean no-storage declarations, not stored content.
source_reuse_privacy_and_storage.counted_records_content: The counted records and assigned narratives use locations, URLs, titles, summaries, and limits. Academic author-site paths used as exact source locators are not stored profile records.
source_reuse_privacy_and_storage.audit_fetch_storage: The two new source records contain paraphrases only, zero direct quoted words, no identities or signatures, and no full page/API body.
source_reuse_privacy_and_storage.limit: This is a scoped review of source evidence, not a formal repository-wide secret/PII or verbatim-string proof. No concrete acceptance-threatening privacy or full-body-storage error was found.
